cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: The new MBO build's 30-min signed-flow (imb_flow) is TOO NOISY to be a usable tick-by-tick direction caller - it flips sign on nearly every completed-event boundary across all four of my days (verified in g15_mbo_feature_states.jsonl). Trusted tick-by-tick it HURTS; a naive flow-follower would have been whipsawed and, on 0318, sold straight into the 02:24 ET reversal low.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.what_is_usable: Only the COARSER MBO grains carry signal: (1) day/phase ABSORPTION (ph_absorb + phase sflow-vs-pxchg divergence), (2) turn detection (onset_dir / turn_kind / turn_et), (3) imb_LEVEL (book/queue imbalance) around turns, which was more persistent than imb_flow (bid-level accumulation held positive through the 0318 overnight floor while imb_flow was flipping). This matches the standing dipole discipline: signed flow is not a direct direction predictor; the static level/absorption read is the detector.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.signed_flow_can_invert_vs_price: 0324 day-level total_sflow = +1355 (net BUY) yet price closed DOWN -350 (absorb_session true) - a direct counterexample to using signed flow directionally. The correct down read came from the D-1 trade conditions (0323 big_print_b_share 0.373 heavy sell) the blind already consumes, NOT from MBO flow.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.net_verdict: The MBO stream mostly CORROBORATES, at the phase/absorption grain, evidence the blind already had at D-1 trade grain; it adds little independent decision-time directional lift and actively HURTS if used tick-by-tick. Its genuine value is turn/absorption CONFIRMATION, not anticipation.

summary.the_0318_turn_diagnosis: Honest per the doctrine's improved-vs-merely-reacted test: the reversal was DETECTABLE-TO-ABANDON-THE-SHORT at the open (D-1 0317 big-print-buy absorption + the 0317 MBO phase-2 absorption + the known 0310 origin shelf as a floor), but the actual turn was an overnight STOP-RUN below the shelf at 02:24 ET followed by absorption - the precise timing and the +1900 magnitude were only knowable REACTIVELY. So the refine genuinely IMPROVES the DIRECTION (real edge: do not press the -400 short, flip to up) but the magnitude precision is partly reaction, which is why my p50 sits at +1500 with moderate confidence, not +1900 with high. The MBO tape's contribution was CONFIRMATION (phase absorption, bid-level recruitment), not anticipation; the anticipatory signal lived in the D-1 trades the open-conditions blind already saw.
summary.mbo_build_working_against_us: YES, materially, if misused. The 30-min imb_flow flips sign on nearly every completed-event boundary on all four days (documented from g15_mbo_feature_states.jsonl) - it is NOT a usable tick-by-tick direction caller and would whipsaw. On 0324 the DAY-level signed flow even inverts vs price (+1355 buy / -350 close). The build is safe and additive ONLY at the coarse grains: phase absorption (ph_absorb), turn detection (onset/turn_kind/turn_et), and imb_LEVEL around turns. Recommend the coordinator gate MBO flow OUT of intraday direction and use it strictly for turn/absorption confirmation, deferring direction to the D-1 trade conditions - which is what actually carried all four of my calls.
summary.weighting_philosophy: Big posterior moves only where causal evidence is material AND at least partly decision-time-legit: a large but honestly-bracketed flip on 0318 (weight 0.55, magnitude held below actual), a clean size-up on 0325 (weight 0.45, aligned flow). Small confirm-only nudges on the two continuation/hold days (0317, 0324; weight 0.15-0.20). Per-event, no averaging.
